newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA SEES LITTLE INTEREST IN 2004 BOND AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: MERITA SEES LITTLE INTEREST IN 2004 BOND AUCTION.

text.p: Merita Bank said recent bond market uncertainty was likely to subdue Thursday's auction of the 2004 serial bond.
"Recent bond market uncertainty is likely to deter bidding in (Thursday's) auction," Merita research said in a pre-auction comment dated November 6.
"Increased domestic political tension, partly caused by Sweden's EMU report, has pushed the (ten-year) yield spread against Germany above 60 bp (basis points)," it said.

Merita said that it did not recommend participation in the auction as a short-term investment, but said as a long-term investment the 2004 bond is attractive, particularly as the bond remains relatively cheap on the curve.
The auction results are due after 1330/1030 GMT. In the previous auction on September 26, the State Treasury raised 1.78 billion markka at a yield of 6.30 percent.
